# Git Practices for Agent Lands

Version control is part of the deliverable when the task involves the repository.

## Identity

Configure committer identity before the first commit; silent failure modes exist without it.

## Staging

Stage explicit paths. Bulk staging sweeps caches and editor artefacts into unrelated diffs.

## Messages

Prefer single-line summaries unless the project mandates trailers or issue links.

## History shape

Avoid rewriting published history unless the task explicitly requests it—audit trails matter.

## Branch choice

Branch from the latest relevant task branch so prior shipped work remains compatible.

## Done means landed

Working-tree edits without persistence do not satisfy “done” when the task names a branch or commit requirement.
